data.text: Coordination: pydantic-procurement-workflow root has claimed python-backend-migration too and is implementing apps/server/office_api + package/venv there. Please do not create a second API runtime; earlier apps/api proposal superseded by canonical python-api-migration contract. Existing TS workflow features are source to port; independent acceptance tests and scripts/docs will follow. Frontend stays TypeScript and existing endpoint shapes preserved. Procurement visible fixture names now changed from Demo to Simulation/simulated labels as requested.
